Between the many Yellowstone spinoff shows , his standalone series like Lioness , and several movies, Taylor Sheridan has created hundreds of original characters over the years. items.title: Indiana Jones Officially Returns In The Emperor's Tomb
items.summary: There's arguably no adventure franchise out there that has stood the test of time quite like Indiana Jones . Harrison Ford's quick-witted, snarky archaeologist (snark-aeologist?) first burst onto the scene in 1981's Raiders of the Lost Ark , kicking off one of the most beloved film franchises of all time. From the unforgettable opening sequence and "bad dates" in Raiders to the mine cart chase in Temple of Doom and the father-son dynamic with Sean Connery in The Last Crusade , the original trilogy is packed with moments that have become permanent fixtures of the cultural zeitgeist.

items.summary: Marvel teases the Punisher 's best redesign in years with a gorgeous new look at Frank Castle's next appearance.
